abstract.t:
This document specifies MoQ Interconnect Exchange (MIX), a protocol that allows Media Over QUIC (MoQ) relays to discover each other, exchange reachability and subscription information, and forward MoQ objects across administrative and topological boundaries. MIX carries its control state as MoQ tracks.
This work is outside the scope of the IETF Media Over QUIC (MoQ) working group. It is discussed on that working group's mailing list, moq@ietf.org, because that is where the people interested in MoQ relay interconnection are.
